integrity: Analytic proof with supplementary finite exact-rational checks; no independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Applies to independent colony reproduction conditional on a shared environment, not interacting spatial colonies.
The two mechanisms compared must share the same survivor-count kernel and capacity at each generation.
Low-capacity d=2,3 survival ordering is already covered in 2020 prior work for geometric-catastrophe trees.
Majorization-based occupancy comparisons could be implicit in broader literature.
title: Pathwise stochastic ordering of four catastrophe–dispersion branching schemes
